Messages.Author: Douglass Bloomer
Messages.Body:
I think in my previous post that I distracted people from the point
that I was/am asking a question.
A quick definition: the 'old' Rotschreck interpretation is that from
the card clarified (redundantly *I* think) in issue #4 of Duelist, that
the effects apply to the attempted target. The FAQ ruling is that the
effects apply to the Vamp attempting to inflict the aggravated damage.

Was there discussion, here or elsewhere, about the old
interpretation causing problems, or even breaking the game? If so, what
were the problems?

As I explained in my first post, in the absence of such a problem I
view the FAQ ruling as very poor. I would like to see this corrected in
time for the V:TES edit. Otherwise we may be stuck with official cards
that *I* believe are wrongly written. Apotential problem far outweighing
the card back issue.

Doug

P.S. Someone asked for impressions on the Combat Ends discussion. I
and my group of players have always interpreted Combat Ends to be
instantaneous and to potentially deprive a blocker of the ability to play
a card for a "strike". We've never noticed any problem with that either.
